chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 661: Female Corpse's Might & the Nine Lamps' Secret
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen wields the Five Emperor Tower with a decaying female corpse, battles Stone Kings, and discovers the nine ancient lamps are tombs of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors.
og_title: Five Emperor Tower Rises, Nine Lamps Revealed as Tombs of the Ancients
og_description: Xiao Chen's desperate use of the female corpse's power triggers the ascent of the nine ancient lamps, revealing their true nature as the graves of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors.
twitter_title: Female Corpse Unleashed; Nine Lamps are Tombs of Emperors
twitter_description: Xiao Chen controls the Five Emperor Tower with a dying corpse, while an ancient being attacks the Nine Provinces and the lamps ascend as ancestral tombs.
